messages.content:
I have three exams in six weeks and I keep freezing up. How should I structure my study?

Be specific — I want something I can follow.

Split the six weeks into three two-week blocks, one subject each, with a final week of mixed recall tests. Study in 40-minute blocks with 10-minute breaks, and every evening write a half-page summary of the day from memory.
Some mornings it feels decided and some it doesn't.
Got it.
